## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model and 5/5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%; others <1% | Overwhelmingly Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.996 / 64th percentile | Typical, usable input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Strongly present; largest pull toward non-invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; spot check 0/20, do not rely [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; small lean toward invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; small lean toward invasive · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) hides detail; the reliability score only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Conformal coverage is dataset-level (92%), not a per-case probability.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5**: rule out infiltrating tumor; top region for invasion, pleomorphism, necrosis, TILs.
2. **Region 4**: check gland formation; strongest tubule score, yet below typical.
3. **Regions 0, 1**: confirm normal lobules by eye; the concept failed its spot check.
